chunks: She said: 'Woe betide me! Will I give birth when I am old and this my husband be aged? This is indeed surprising!'

key_terms.يَا وَيْلَتَا: Woe betide me / Exclamation of wonder

ai.seo_question: What did the matriarch say about giving birth in old age?
ai.summary: In Surah Hud, this verse captures the astonishment of the Prophet's wife (traditionally identified as Sarah in Shia and Sunni exegesis, though sometimes linked to Hajar or Khadijah in broader narrative contexts) upon hearing the glad tidings of Isaac's birth. It underscores the divine power to overturn natural laws, serving as a precursor to the miraculous births of prophets and emphasizing God's ability to grant offspring to the elderly.
